name: codec-tts
description: Generic codec-based TTS fine-tune via teacher-forcing cross-entropy. Works with VUI (Fluac codec) and similar quantizer-based TTS models.
pipDeps: huggingface-hub hf_xet hf_transfer torch torchaudio soundfile julius einops tiktoken transformers pydantic numba inflect gradio safetensors pandas pyarrow
notes: Codec MUST be frozen. Text embedding optionally frozen (--freeze-text-emb). Cross-entropy over all quantizers. 3000 steps on 8h data achieves loss ~4.95.

smokeVerify.pythonInline:
import sys, torch, soundfile as sf
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/model/src')
from vui.model import Vui
from vui.inference import generate
import glob
ckpts = sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/checkpoints/erinome_step*.pt'))
assert ckpts, 'no checkpoints found'
ckpt = torch.load(ckpts[-1], map_location='cuda', weights_only=False)
m = Vui.from_pretrained('/workspace/model/vui-100m-base.pt').cuda()
m.load_state_dict(ckpt['model'])
m.eval()
codes = generate(m, 'Olá, teste de smoke.', temperature=0.5)
wav = m.codec.from_indices(codes).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
sf.write('/workspace/smoke_test.wav', wav, 22050)
rms = float((wav**2).mean()**0.5)
assert len(wav)/22050 > 0.3 and rms > 0.005
print('[smoke-verify] OK')
